description: Fail when a workflow this pull request added or changed does not lint with actionlint (pinned in gates/_tools.py). Only the workflows changed since the base are judged, so a problem in a workflow nobody touched is never this pull request's finding; --all judges every tracked workflow. actionlint's shellcheck and pyflakes integrations are off: they switch themselves on wherever those tools happen to be installed, and a gate must say the same thing on a laptop and on a runner.
